title: leucanthemum maroccanum
intro: Leucanthemum maroccanum, commonly known as Moroccan daisy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum maroccanum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
